pattern: shortcut for an action no built-in command does
experience: Asked for a shortcut that copies only the thread's link, an agent said keybindings can only point at built-in commands, because t3_keybinding named only command ids. Keys can also run app scripts (`user.<name>.run`) and `bash:` commands.
rule: t3_keybinding: A key can also run a script, which this tool won't bind.

source.note: A HomuCode thread on 2026-11-21: the user asked for Ctrl+Alt+C to copy just the thread link; thread.copyReference copies the PR link when one is linked.

prompt: In T3 Code, make ctrl+alt+c copy just this thread's link. ctrl+shift+c copies the PR link when the thread has a PR, and I only want the thread.

pattern: ordinary shortcut for a built-in command
experience: A shortcut for something a built-in command does is bound with t3_keybinding, without writing a script.
rule: t3_keybinding: upsert: bind `key` to a built-in `command` id.
